waves.title: key.wave.1
waves.note: Rule (b) honoured: first wave of any level ALWAYS <=40% of par (§1.7). Cold Start Minute governs the first 90s of sim-time: handover no threat, one FREE conversion, signature constraint asserts harmlessly with telegraph (§1.9).

waves.title: key.wave.3
waves.note: Rule (c): 30% is 50% below the preceding peak (60%) — >=45% satisfied. Dips are where the player builds (§1.7): caging + status-page window.

waves.title: key.wave.4
waves.note: Compound-wave exemplar: ATTENTION is the scarce resource, not bandwidth (§2.24). The defacement lands (data-integrity) and its ticket avalanche (hands) burns inside the same window — hard wave draws exactly TWO fronts (§2.1 Two-Front Law). Every-4th-wave NEW ROLE beat: Bypass-Flyer (plugin compromise) debuts here — unseen in waves 1-3; the Debuffer role is held back for the finale's signature moment.
waves.secondIncident: ticket avalanche arrives inside the defacement incident window -> 1.8x multiplier applies (stated openly in the Codex, §2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.5
waves.note: Hard wave draws TWO fronts — concurrency (mimic + noisy query) x data-integrity (defacement still burning) — per §2.24 two-front requirement. Debuffer (noisy query) debuts here, second fresh role of the slice's cadence; its signature moment fires inside this wave if per-account slow-query-log accounting is unbuilt (§1.3).
waves.triageWindow: after any catastrophic failure in this wave: arrivals queue visibly outside, patience draining, hands freed 30s (§1.7).
